name: Well Of Water
overview: Scripture reveals the 'Well of Water' as a profound symbol of God's provision and sustaining grace, offering living water that satisfies spiritual thirst eternally. Isaiah portrays this well as a source of salvation and blessing poured out by God on the thirsty and dry ground, while Jeremiah contrasts it with broken cisterns that fail to hold water, highlighting human failure to rely on God. In the New Testament, Jesus identifies Himself as the giver of living water, promising that those who drink from Him will never thirst again but will have a spring of eternal life within them.
